arabic_reviews.positive:
This property looks exactly like the pictures. It was clean, comfortable and the location is terrific. 
Located in a quiet street in Old town, close to a good night and morning market so we didn’t even need to cook. Also close to a good massage place and a famous Khao Soi place. 
Facilities are well maintained and equipped with everything you’ll need for a nice relaxing holiday. We loved the kids corner, and even had a highchair and kids dinnerware. Both rooms are massive, and have its own ensuite. 
You have your own private carport. 
Definitely recommend this place to a family looking for a good place to stay in Chiang mai.

Great apartment, you have the whole house for yourself! Very much room and everything well equipped and comfortable. The host is really nice and helpful with all questions. The street is very quiet and it is right next to the old town and a small night market with great food. Definitely a big recommendation! We would love to stay there again!

Location excellent for us, walkable, close enough to food market and convenience store, restaurants, taxi finding you in and out easy,  quiet street.  The house is as shown in the listing, it is very comfortable, has parking, nice kitchen. Clean!🙏

It was beautiful and clean, spacious and such a retreat for the whole family. The beds were big, clean and comfortable. It was wonderful having a washer and dryer there to clean our clothes. Will definitely stay here again.
The house is very spacious and spotlessly clean. It’s close to the market and many eateries. I love everything about this place and will definitely be back.
